Are you an experienced Finance Assistant searching for a new opportunity? We are looking for a Part Time Finance Assistant to join their team on a permanent basis. This role offers a great chance to be involved in essential financial processes, supporting the wider business with purchase ledger tasks, reconciliation, and basic account management. You'll be working closely with the finance team, ensuring smooth and accurate handling of transactions, all while maintaining a welcoming and professional approach. The position is office-based in Bath, perfect for someone looking to balance work and personal commitments, with a flexible, part-time schedule.

DAY TO DAY:
- Accounts payable, processing supplier invoices, using ApprovalMax, ensuring all invoices are allocated correctly, preparing invoices for approval
- Maintain the Accounts payable ledger and payment runs
- Reconcile supplier statements and resolving discrepancies, supplier onboarding and data capture
- Accounts receivable to include checking of rents, service charges, credit control, chasing payments, providing reports to Financial Controller
- Maintaining the ledger, allocating receipts, updating tenant accounts,
- Daily bank reconciliations, posting receipts and journals as needed, credit card reconciliations, tenant deposits,
- Providing reports to the team for service charge budgets using Xero, liaising with wider team re all finance queries,
- Assisting in the preparation of month-end, assisting with preparation of year-end
- Maintain an organised digital filing system, support FC with any other duties, support wider team when required

WE WOULD LOVE TO SEE:
- Previous experience as a Finance or Accounts Assistant, ideally in property or similar sector
- Knowledge of purchase ledger processes and financial reconciliations
- Confidence using accounting software, with experience in Xero being highly desirable
- Strong organisational skills and attention to detail
- Excellent communication skills and a proactive attitude
- Ability to work independently and as part of a team

AND FOR YOU:
- Benefits include competitive salary
- Flexible working hours - 5 shorter days or 3 full days
- Central Bath, modern office environment in established team

title: Customer Service Advisor
description:
Customer Service Advisor

Red Recruitment is recruiting a Customer Service Advisor to join our client's busy customer contact team on a temporary basis.

You will support customers across telephone, email, live chat and social media, answering a wide variety of queries relating to products, orders and installations. You will take ownership of each enquiry, working to resolve questions and complaints effectively while delivering a positive customer experience.

Package for a Customer Service Advisor:

Salary: 13.46 - 14.56 per hour, depending on experience
Hours: 40 hours per week, Monday to Saturday. Saturdays are worked on a rota, with a day off during the week
Contract: Temporary
Location: Bath, hybrid
- Varied, multichannel customer service role
- Opportunity to develop your complaint-handling and problem-solving experience
- Supportive and collaborative working environment
- Saturday shifts balanced with a weekday off

Key Responsibilities of a Customer Service Advisor:
- Responding to customer enquiries through telephone, email, live chat and social media
- Providing accurate information about products, orders and installations
- Taking ownership of customer enquiries through to resolution
- Handling complaints professionally and working towards first-contact resolution
- Contacting customers to arrange installations, explain the process and answer questions
- Listening carefully to customers and identifying the most appropriate solution
- Communicating complex information in a clear and accessible way
- Contributing ideas to improve processes across the team and wider business
- Sharing useful information with colleagues and updating internal knowledge systems
- Maintaining a professional, empathetic and positive approach throughout every interaction

Key Skills and Experience of a Customer Service Advisor:
- Previous B2 C customer service experience gained within a contact centre, retail or another customer-focused environment
- Experience handling complaints and taking ownership through to resolution
- Confident and professional verbal and written communication skills
- Strong listening and questioning skills
- Ability to simplify complex information and explain it clearly
- Empathetic approach and the ability to communicate with customers from a wide range of backgrounds
- Good problem-solving skills and a proactive attitude
- Working knowledge of Microsoft Office
- Positive, can-do approach with a willingness to learn and develop

If you are an experienced customer service professional who enjoys solving problems and taking ownership of customer enquiries, please apply now!

This service is a partnership between Alzheimers Society and Devon Partnership NHS Trust, supporting people living with dementia and their carers. You will be joining a dynamic team that provides vital services to people living with dementia and their families. What We Are Looking For: Previous administrative experience, especially in call handling and using emails, word processing, and spreadsheets. Strong communication skills, with the ability to be friendly and empathetic when interacting with people. Excellent organisational skills, able to manage your time and work independently. Profile: Excellent planning and organisation skills Excellent written and verbal communication skills Excellent attention to detail Professional telephone manner Collegiate approach and diligent Takes pride in their work and consistently strives to produce work of the highest standard Seeks to deliver the best possible outcome rather than just the task at hand Works in partnership with the Manager/associated team to understand their needs and priorities (which may change depending on workload) Excellent time management skills Experience of prioritising a varied and busy workload Experience of working under pressure with the ability to work to and achieve deadlines The role will involve the development and implementation of office procedures and will require a high degree of organisational skills and excellent working knowledge of administrative practices.

title: GP Receptionist
description: We are looking for a friendly, organised and compassionate Receptionist to join our busy GP practice. As the first point of contact for patients, you will play a vital role in providing excellent customer service, helping patients access the care they need, and supporting the smooth day-to-day running of the practice. This is a rewarding opportunity for someone who enjoys working with people, thrives in a fast-paced environment, and is committed to delivering high-quality patient care. As a GP Receptionist, you will be the first point of contact for patients, providing a friendly and professional service both in person and over the telephone. Duties include booking and managing appointments, signposting patients to the most appropriate service, handling enquiries, processing requests, maintaining accurate patient records, and supporting the smooth day-to-day running of the practice. You will work closely with clinicians and colleagues to ensure patients receive timely access to care while maintaining confidentiality at all times. The following are the core responsibilities of the Receptionist role. There may be, on occasion, a requirement to carry out other tasks. This will be dependent upon factors such as workload and staffing levels: To have a thorough knowledge of all practice procedures To work in accordance with written protocols Maintain and monitor the practice appointment system Process personal, telephone and e-requests for appointments Answer incoming phone calls, transferring calls or dealing with the callers requests appropriately and efficiently Signpost patients to the correct service Initiating contact with and responding to requests from patients, team members and external agencies Code data onto the clinical IT system Photocopy documentation as required Data entry of new and temporary registrations and relevant patient information as required Input data into patients healthcare records as necessary Direct requests for information, i.e., SAR, insurance/solicitors letters and DVLA forms to the administrative team Manage all queries as necessary in an efficient manner Complete opening and closing procedures in accordance with the duty rota Maintain a clean, tidy, effective working area at all times Monitor and maintain the reception area and notice boards Support all clinical and administrative/management staff with general tasks as requested.

title: Medical Secretary/Administrator
description: Greenway Community Practice is delighted to offer a rare opportunity to join our friendly, supportive and well-established team as an Medical Secretary/ Administrator. This is an ideal opportunity for an organised, enthusiastic and motivated individual looking to develop their career within primary care. The successful candidate will provide high-quality administrative and medical secretarial support to our clinical and administrative teams, helping to ensure the smooth and efficient running of the practice. You will provide a varied range of administrative and medical secretarial support, including managing clinical correspondence and referrals, supporting clinicians, processing workflow and accurately read-coding relevant information into patients electronic healthcare records. You will also provide administrative support to our wider multidisciplinary team and liaise with healthcare professionals and other organisations as required. More than anything, we value your energy and outlook - because we believe a positive, motivated team is key to delivering outstanding care. If youre looking to be part of a fun, dynamic team that genuinely enjoys working together, wed love to hear from you. The successful candidate will provide a high-quality medical secretarial service, supporting GPs and clinicians with the efficient management of patient-related administrative processes. Duties will include preparing and processing clinical correspondence, referrals, reports and other medical documentation. The post holder will be responsible for processing and tracking referrals, investigations and hospital correspondence, liaising with secondary care providers and other healthcare professionals where appropriate. The role will also involve monitoring and actioning incoming correspondence, scanning and filing clinical documents, allocating tasks to the appropriate clinician or team member, and following up outstanding actions where required. The post holder will ensure that confidential patient information is handled appropriately and in accordance with practice policies, information governance requirements and data protection legislation. In addition, the successful candidate will carry out workflow processes and accurately read-code relevant information into patients electronic healthcare records, in accordance with the practices coding policy and agreed procedures. Attention to detail and an understanding of medical terminology will be essential to ensure that clinical information is recorded accurately and consistently. Secretarial Opening Incoming post, internal and external, date stamp and circulate as appropriate. Sending outgoing post, internal and external, as required Typing GP referral letters and general correspondence, using eRs Typing Agendas and Minutes as required General typing, such as posters, leaflets, protocols etc., as required. Liaise with various hospital departments/secretaries regarding patient appointments/results/letters etc. as required. Use ICE to obtain results/clinic letters/appointment details etc. as required. Deal with patient enquiries regarding hospital appointments etc. Maintain the Private Fees Account, keeping a record of requests, responses, and payments in Deal with requests from Solicitors/Insurance Companies/Employers for Medical Reports, PMA Reports, copies of records etc.; prepare documentation as required; liaise with GPs to ensure a response; complete and send off. Deal with requests from Insurance Companies or individual patients for medicals; book appointments and liaise with GPs; sendoff reports. Deal with sundry and private fees payments coming in; enter on Private Fees Account and prepare regularly for banking. Devise protocols for secretarial duties Monitor the practice NHS.net email inbox throughout the day. Review and action incoming emails promptly. Forward emails to the appropriate staff member when required. Add patient-related emails to Docman for processing and filing
